subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the best answer.

Smartphones have become an essential part of our daily lives. According to a recent survey, about 90% of young people in Viet Nam own a smartphone. These devices allow users to communicate with friends, study online, and even shop without leaving home. However, experts warn that spending too much time on smartphones can be harmful. Students who use their phones for more than five hours a day often find it difficult to concentrate in class. They may also suffer from eye strain and poor sleep quality. Therefore, many schools now encourage students to limit screen time and take part in outdoor activities. Parents are also advised to set clear rules about phone use at home. Used wisely, smartphones can be a wonderful learning tool instead of a distraction.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Smartphones are dangerous devices that should be banned.
Smartphones bring many benefits but should be used wisely.

explanation: Bài nói về lợi ích của smartphone và lời khuyên dùng hợp lý ('Used wisely, smartphones can be a wonderful learning tool').

prompt:

explanation: Câu thứ hai của bài: 'about 90% of young people in Viet Nam own a smartphone'.

The word 'They' in paragraph 2 refers to ___.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage (thông tin như câu trước).

Which of the following is NOT mentioned as advice in the passage?
explanation: Bài nêu: hạn chế thời gian màn hình, tham gia hoạt động ngoài trời, quy định dùng điện thoại; không nêu bán điện thoại.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage (thông tin như câu trước).

What can be inferred from the last sentence of the passage?

options.text: Smartphones are always harmful to students.
With proper use, smartphones can support learning.
Parents do not care about phone use.

explanation: 'Used wisely, smartphones can be a wonderful learning tool instead of a distraction' — dùng đúng cách thì điện thoại hỗ trợ học tập.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage and choose the best answer.

Going green is becoming more popular in Viet Nam. Many families now bring their own bags to the market instead of using plastic ones. Supermarkets have started selling paper bags and encouraging customers to reuse them. In big cities, young people take part in campaigns to collect rubbish on beaches and plant trees in their neighbourhoods. These small actions help reduce pollution and protect the environment for future generations. Experts say that everyone can contribute to a greener planet by saving energy at home, recycling waste, and using public transport more often. Although one person's effort may seem small, millions of people doing the same thing can make a big difference.

What is the main idea of the passage?

options.text: Plastic bags are cheap and convenient.
Beaches in Viet Nam are very dirty.
Small individual actions can help protect the environment.

explanation: Ý chính: những hành động nhỏ của mỗi người góp phần bảo vệ môi trường.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the passage (thông tin như câu trước).

Many families bring their own bags to the market in order to ___.
explanation: 'instead of using plastic ones' — mang túi riêng để hạn chế túi ni-lông.

The word 'campaigns' in the passage is closest in meaning to ___.
explanation: 'Campaigns' là các hoạt động có tổ chức (chiến dịch).

The phrase 'make a big difference' in the last sentence means ___.

According to the passage, protecting the environment is ___.
explanation: 'Everyone can contribute to a greener planet' — trách nhiệm của tất cả mọi người.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Camping is a popular activity among young people. (1) ___. First, it helps them relax after stressful school days. Second, they can learn useful skills such as cooking and teamwork. Finally, camping trips create wonderful memories with friends.

options.text: There are several reasons why camping is good for students.
Camping is very expensive for families.
Camping is not allowed in Viet Nam.

explanation: Câu dẫn giới thiệu 'First, Second, Finally' cần một câu khái quát về các lý do.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

My neighbourhood has changed a lot in the last five years. (1) ___. There is also a new park where children play every afternoon. The streets are cleaner, and people seem happier.

options.text: The park has been closed for years.
A new shopping mall was built near the market last year.
I dislike living in this neighbourhood.
The roads are still very narrow.

explanation: Câu điền phải nêu một sự thay đổi tích cực, phù hợp với nội dung đoạn.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Reading books brings many benefits. (1) ___. It also improves vocabulary and writing skills. Moreover, books help us understand other people and cultures.

options.text: First of all, reading is a great way to gain knowledge.
I never read books in my free time.

explanation: Câu đầu của chuỗi lý do ('It also...', 'Moreover...') phải là lợi ích đầu tiên.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Learning a foreign language takes time and patience. (1) ___. Listening to songs and watching films also make learning more enjoyable. With regular practice, anyone can make progress.

options.text: Learners should practise speaking every day.
Only young children can learn languages.

explanation: Câu điền đưa ra lời khuyên học, dẫn vào các ví dụ 'Listening to songs...'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Volunteering is good for both the community and the volunteers themselves. (1) ___. They also learn new skills and make new friends. Many volunteers say the experience makes them more confident.

options.text: Volunteers help poor children, old people, and people with disabilities.
Volunteers want to become rich quickly.
Volunteering is banned in many schools.

explanation: Câu điền nêu việc làm của tình nguyện viên, phù hợp 'They also learn new skills...'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the paragraph and choose the sentence that best fits the gap.

Recycling paper saves trees and energy. (1) ___. In addition, recycling produces less rubbish in landfills. Schools can start recycling programmes to teach students this good habit.

options.text: Paper is no longer used today.
Recycled paper is used to make boxes and notebooks.

explanation: Câu điền nêu tác dụng của giấy tái chế, hợp nghĩa với chủ đề tiết kiệm cây.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

The new library ___ to the public last month.
explanation: 'Last month' → quá khứ đơn, thư viện bị mở cho công chúng: câu bị động 'was opened'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

If I ___ more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 2: If + quá khứ đơn, would + động từ nguyên mẫu.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

She is looking forward to ___ her grandparents next weekend.
explanation: 'look forward to + V-ing' (gerund).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

The film was ___ interesting that we watched it twice.
explanation: Cấu trúc 'so + tính từ + that': quá ... đến nỗi ....

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

Neither of the two answers ___ correct.
explanation: 'Neither of ...' chủ ngữ số ít → động từ số ít 'is'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the best option to complete the sentence.

The man ___ lives next door is a famous artist.
explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'who' thay cho người, làm chủ ngữ của mệnh đề quan hệ.
